title: Which TCL TVs Have Bang & Olufsen Audio? - BGR
summary: Popular audio formats like Dolby Atmos and DTS:X are compatible with most TCL TVs and soundbars, though you'll want to make sure you're connecting via HDMI ARC/eARC for the best sound (digital optical won't cut it).
